title: Cupped Twelve Window Blade And Round Shaft Floorball Stick
description: One newly authored complete static floorball-inspired stick. A broad low laterally cupped blade has twelve genuine through windows in two rows, all surrounded by one continuous finite perimeter and integral crossing ribs. The complete blade rises into a solid integral heel neck, rooted to a whole long inclined round shaft and a separate complete closed upper grip. A continuous lower blade strip supplies a finite resting surface; the toe lifts and sweeps laterally, not the previous entirely planar solid ice-hockey toe. Three complete new closed meshes and three opaque constant PBR roles, native metres and Z up, horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. No old hockey outline, lacrosse scoop/string pocket or snowshoe frame/web geometry reused. One original decorative model and zero scenes. Empty fixed visual only: no ball, player, court, logos, textures, animation, simulated flex, replaceable-blade mechanism, grip fit, sports standards, ball-control performance, strength, manufacture, real equipment usability or safety certification.
